subject: english
stem: What happens next in this passage after “They checked their bags.”?
options: Both lunch boxes were blue, and both had no names on them.
But teachers noticed that students finished eating more slowly and left fewer lunch boxes unfinished.
Anna looked carefully and saw a small blue flower on one end.
At the school fair, students could buy blue tickets to play games.

本文沒有陳述「Anna looked carefully and saw a small blue flower on one end.」；這個選項混入另一個情境的資訊。
